verdict.rationale: Abandoned-cart recovery is a fair question for an e-commerce platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents WooCommerce detecting abandoned carts or checkouts, or sending recovery emails or links. Webhooks, the Store API and generic marketplace extensions are only developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a merchant, abandoned carts and checkouts trigger recovery emails or links so I can win the sale back
